verdict.rationale: There is no evidence of an API, programmatic export, or agent-accessible endpoint for cap table or data room data — probes for llms.txt, docs.md, and OpenAPI all returned 404. The product offers smart-linking between cap table and data room within its own UI, but nothing supports programmatic/agent-driven pulling or reconciliation. Missing for 10: any public API, developer docs, or third-party integration enabling automated/agentic data retrieval and reconciliation.
